title: [Bug]: TypeError : Object of type ModelMetaclass is not JSON serializable when using SqliteLogger
body:
### Describe the bug

when using SqliteLogger, "log_chat_completion" fails with:
`Object of type ModelMetaclass is not JSON serializable`

### Steps to reproduce
```python
from autogen import LLMConfig, runtime_logging
from autogen.agents.experimental import DocAgent

llm_config = LLMConfig(api_type="openai", model="gpt-4o")

runtime_logging.start(logger_type="sqlite")
# Create our DocAgent
with llm_config:
    document_agent = DocAgent()

# Update this path to suit your environment
response = document_agent.run(
    message="Can you ingest ../test/agentchat/contrib/graph_rag/Toast_financial_report.pdf and tell me the fiscal year 2024 financial summary?",
    max_turns=1
)

# Iterate through the chat automatically with console output
response.process()
```

### Model Used

_No response_

### Expected Behavior

To successfully log the chat completion.
